subject.title: Require Codex scan artifact coverage proof

question: Should ClawHub enforce `artifact_coverage` as a required fail-closed condition before benign Codex worker results can be stored as clean?
rationale: This changes the authoritative ClawScan worker trust boundary and can stop existing benign worker outputs until the new model/schema contract is reliably rolled out.

options.title: Repair, refresh, then enforce
options.body: Fix the zero-byte verifier case, resolve current-main conflicts, and merge only after maintainers accept fail-closed coverage proof for benign results.

options.title: Accept the contract risk
options.body: Maintainers can intentionally require the new output shape immediately, but should own the worker availability and rollout impact.

options.title: Pause the contract change
options.body: Keep the draft paused or close it in favor of a narrower security-boundary design issue if the rollout is not ready.

recommendation.title: Repair, refresh, then enforce
recommendation.body: Fix the zero-byte verifier case, resolve current-main conflicts, and merge only after maintainers accept fail-closed coverage proof for benign results.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent worker artifact-read and current-main worker/schema history make this the clearest owner for the contract and upgrade decision.
